d: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un is turning up the pressure on the Korean Peninsula. After watching a display of unmanned weapons, Kim Jong Un, called for 'absolute superiority' in drone technology, A day before, North Korea fired around 10 ballistic missiles towards the sea off its east coast. The latest military activity comes amid rising tensions with South Korea and weeks before the APEC summit in China. Is Kim preparing for conflict, or using military muscle to strengthen his position on the world stage?
